# AskMukthiGuru

> Spiritual reflection and guided practice inspired by Sri Preethaji & Sri Krishnaji. Check source attribution and service availability before relying on a response.

AskMukthiGuru offers spiritual reflection, guided practices (including Serene Mind), and an inquiry interface designed to retrieve recorded teachings. Teacher quotations must be verbatim and source-linked. Related excerpts are not necessarily direct answers; when evidence or the service is unavailable, the app should say so rather than invent a teaching. It is not medical treatment or emergency care. See Trust and Privacy for sourcing, limitations, and data handling.

## Pages

- [Home](https://askmukthiguru.lovable.app/): Landing page, product overview, meet the gurus.
- [Chat](https://askmukthiguru.lovable.app/chat): Talk with the AI spiritual guide.
- [Practices](https://askmukthiguru.lovable.app/practices): Meditation and reflection practices catalog.
- [AI Spiritual Companion](https://askmukthiguru.lovable.app/guides/ai-spiritual-companion): Source-linked teaching limits and how to use the companion safely.
- [Trust](https://askmukthiguru.lovable.app/trust): Source attribution, response labels, safety, and limitations.

## Guides

- [AI Spiritual Guide](https://askmukthiguru.lovable.app/guides/ai-spiritual-companion): How to evaluate sourced teachings and use reflection alongside existing practices.
- [Beautiful State Meditation](https://askmukthiguru.lovable.app/guides/beautiful-state-meditation): How to enter the Beautiful State.
- [Serene Mind Practice](https://askmukthiguru.lovable.app/guides/serene-mind-practice): The 3-minute Serene Mind meditation for stress.
- [Self-Centric Thinking](https://askmukthiguru.lovable.app/guides/self-centric-thinking): Stop overthinking spiritually.
- [Spiritual Guide for Anxiety](https://askmukthiguru.lovable.app/guides/spiritual-guide-for-anxiety): Using AI spiritual guidance to work with anxiety.
- [From Suffering to Beautiful State](https://askmukthiguru.lovable.app/guides/suffering-to-beautiful-state): Moving from the suffering state to the Beautiful State.
